verdict.rationale: Monorepo workspaces with a shared lockfile and cross-linked local dependencies is a fair question for a package manager and build tool like Nix, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents workspaces, a shared lockfile, or linking local packages to each other. The flake creation and build commands (nix-docs-39, nix-docs-14) and reproducible dev environments are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage many packages in one monorepo with workspaces sharing a single lockfile and cross-linked local dependencies
